<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const el = (name, attrs, parent) => {
    const node = document.createElementNS(ns, name);
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attrs)) node.setAttribute(key, value);
    parent.appendChild(node);
    return node;
  };

  const body = $("body");
  const tail = $("tail");
  const earBack = $("earBack");
  const earFront = $("earFront");
  const eye = $("eye");
  const meadow = $("meadow");

  const tau = 2 * Math.PI;
  const cycle = 1.48;
  const stance = .64;
  const halfStep = 27;
  const beltSpeed = 1.16 * (2 * halfStep) / (cycle * stance);
  const mod = (value, period) => ((value % period) + period) % period;

  // A lateral-sequence, four-beat walk: left hind, left fore, right hind, right fore.
  const legs = [
    { x: -86, y: -130, floor: -7, phase: .50, upper: 66, lower: 66, bend: 1,  width: 13, far: true },

    { x:  49, y: -140, floor:  5, phase: .25, upper: 76, lower: 73, bend: -1, width: 15, far: false }
  ];

  for (const leg of legs) {
    leg.shadow = el("ellipse", { fill: "url(#shade)", ry: 4 }, $("contacts"));
    const group = el("g", { class: leg.far ? "leg far" : "leg" }, $(leg.far ? "farLegs" : "nearLegs"));
    leg.coat = el("path", { class: "coat" }, group);
    leg.light = el("path", { class: "light" }, group);
    leg.foot = el("g", {}, group);
    el("path", {
      class: "hoof",
      d: "M-6-9Q-1-7 5-8Q9-7 11-4L12-1Q12 1 9 1H-4Q-8 1-8-2Z"
    }, leg.foot);
    el("path", {
      d: "M-4-5Q1-5 5-4M6-3Q7-1 6 1",
      fill: "none", stroke: "#c99b8a", "stroke-width": ".85", "stroke-linecap": "round", opacity: ".67"
    }, leg.foot);
  }

  const point = (x, y) => ({x, y});
  const offset = (p, n, w) => point(p.x + n.x * w, p.y + n.y * w);
  const mix = (a, b, w) => point(a.x + (b.x-a.x)*w, a.y + (b.y-a.y)*w);
  const unit = (x, y) => {
    const length = Math.hypot(x, y) || 1;
    return point(x/length, y/length);
  };
  const normal = (a, b) => unit(b.y-a.y, a.x-b.x);
  const xy = p => `${p.x.toFixed(2)} ${p.y.toFixed(2)}`;

  function drawLeg(leg, stride, bob, angle) {
    const phase = mod(stride - leg.phase, 1);
    let travel, lift = 0, pitch = 0;
    if (phase < stance) {
      // The planted foot travels backward at exactly the speed of the meadow.
      travel = halfStep * (1 - 2 * phase / stance);
    } else {
      const u = (phase - stance) / (1 - stance);
      // Match the speed at both ends of the swing so toes leave and land without a hitch.
      const tangent = -2 * halfStep * (1 - stance) / stance;
      travel = -halfStep + 2 * halfStep * u*u*(3-2*u) + tangent * u*(1-u)*(1-2*u);
      lift = (leg.bend > 0 ? 25 : 30) * Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * u), 1.8) * (1.12 - .24*u);
      pitch = -24 * Math.sin(tau * u) * Math.sin(Math.PI * u);
    }

    const fx = leg.x + travel, fy = leg.floor - lift;
    const pivotY = -149, c = Math.cos(angle), s = Math.sin(angle);
    const hip = point(leg.x*c - (leg.y-pivotY)*s, pivotY + bob + leg.x*s + (leg.y-pivotY)*c);
    const ankle = point(fx + 5*Math.sin(pitch*Math.PI/180), fy - 6);
    const axis = unit(ankle.x - hip.x, ankle.y - hip.y);
    const dist = Math.min(Math.hypot(ankle.x-hip.x, ankle.y-hip.y), leg.upper+leg.lower-.01);
    const along = (leg.upper**2 - leg.lower**2 + dist**2) / (2*dist);
    const bend = leg.bend * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, leg.upper**2 - along**2));
    const knee = point(hip.x + axis.x*along + axis.y*bend, hip.y + axis.y*along - axis.x*bend);

    const n1 = normal(hip, knee), n2 = normal(knee, ankle);
    const nk = unit(n1.x+n2.x, n1.y+n2.y);
    const w = leg.width, joint = leg.far ? 8 : 9.5, cuff = leg.far ? 5.15 : 5.9;
    const a = offset(hip,n1,w), b = offset(knee,nk,joint), c1 = offset(ankle,n2,cuff);
    const d = offset(ankle,n2,-cuff), e = offset(knee,nk,-joint), f = offset(hip,n1,-w);
    const mid1 = mix(hip,knee,.54), mid2 = mix(knee,ankle,.58);
    leg.coat.setAttribute("d",
      `M${xy(a)} Q${xy(offset(mid1,n1,w*.85))} ${xy(b)}
       Q${xy(offset(mid2,n2,cuff+1))} ${xy(c1)} Q${fx} ${fy-2} ${xy(d)}
       Q${xy(offset(mid2,n2,-cuff-1))} ${xy(e)}
       Q${xy(offset(mid1,n1,-w*.72))} ${xy(f)} Z`);
    leg.light.setAttribute("d",
      `M${xy(offset(mix(hip,knee,.49),n1,joint-2))}
       Q${xy(offset(knee,nk,joint-3))} ${xy(offset(mix(knee,ankle,.76),n2,2.7))}`);
    leg.foot.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${fx} ${fy}) rotate(${pitch})`);
    leg.shadow.setAttribute("cx", fx+1);
    leg.shadow.setAttribute("cy", leg.floor+.5);
    leg.shadow.setAttribute("rx", 17 + lift*.32);
    leg.shadow.setAttribute("opacity", Math.max(.16, .85-lift*.025));
  }

  const start = performance.now();
  function animate(now) {
    const t = (now - start) / 1000;
    const stride = t / cycle + .58;
    const wave = tau * stride;
    const bob = 1.8*Math.cos(2*wave+.1) + .55*Math.cos(4*wave-.55);
    const tilt = .95*Math.sin(2*wave-.7) + .34*Math.sin(wave+.6);

    body.setAttribute("transform", `translate(0 ${bob}) rotate(${tilt} 0 -149)`);
    tail.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${4.8*Math.sin(wave-.8)+1.2*Math.sin(2*wave)} -137 -164)`);
    const flick = Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.cos(tau*t/7.4+1.2)), 34);
    earBack.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${1.8*Math.sin(wave+.8)-8*flick} 90 -296)`);
    earFront.setAttribute("transform", `rotate(${1.25*Math.sin(wave-.35)+3.7*flick} 118 -297)`);
    const blinkTime = mod(t+2.8, 5.7);
    const blink = blinkTime < .16 ? Math.sin(Math.PI*blinkTime/.16)**2 : 0;
    eye.setAttribute("transform", `translate(0 -268) scale(1 ${1-.95*blink}) translate(0 268)`);

    for (const leg of legs) drawLeg(leg, stride, bob, tilt*Math.PI/180);
    meadow.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${-mod(t*beltSpeed,1440)} 0)`);
    foreground.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${-mod(t*beltSpeed*1.26,1440)} 0)`);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  animate(start);
})();
</script>
</body>
